response.sql: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as product_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(product_count) as total_count FROM product_counts), shares AS (SELECT pc.product_id, pc.product_count, CAST(pc.product_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / CAST(ts.total_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share FROM product_counts pc CROSS JOIN total_sum ts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as average_share FROM shares), filtered AS (SELECT s.product_count, s.share, a.average_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.average_share) SELECT SUM(product_count) as combined_count, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - average_share) as average_excess FROM filtered
